subject: Renewal proposal — reserved GPU pool + throughput guarantees
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Zoe Chen <zoe@zenith.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal — reserved GPU pool + throughput guarantees

Hi Zoe —

Thanks again for the productive QBR last week. Per our conversation I ran a short capacity plan based on Zenith's trailing 90-day usage and your Q3 product roadmap. The summary:

- Observed steady-state inference: ~420 QPS across the fleet during peak windows, ~1.1M tokens/day average.
- Forecasted growth: ~30–40% QoQ (forecasting conservative 35% growth into the renewal year given new features).
- Recommended reserved pool: 6x H100 GPUs as a baseline reserved capacity with a 2x burst buffer (on-demand) for marketing-day spikes.
- Throughput guarantee: target 450 QPS sustained with 95th percentile latency SLO of 180ms for text-gen workloads under this configuration.

Attached: zenith-current-usage-report.csv and a draft SKU sheet (proposed-dedicated-sku.pdf).

Ask: Can you confirm whether your preference is a 12- or 24-month term? We can price both; 24-month gets a steeper discount and priority scaling windows. If procurement wants guaranteed throughput written into the contract we will include an SLA appendix and a defined rollback/fallback policy.

If that sounds reasonable I’ll kick off an internal pricing and contract run with Marissa and Neha.

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: zenith-current-usage-report.csv (CSV)]
[Attachment: proposed-dedicated-sku.pdf (PDF)]

From: Zoe Chen <zoe@zenith.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@zenith.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal — reserved GPU pool + throughput guarantees

Thanks Rafael — this is very helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) The 35% QoQ forecast aligns with product expectations. We are comfortable budgeting for that range.
2) Procurement will ask for two items before sign: a clear throughput guarantee (QPS + latency SLO) and an option to increase the reserved pool mid-term with short notice.
3) We prefer a 24-month term if the pricing delta is significant.

I’ve looped Procurement on this thread (procurement@zenith.ai). They’ll want a formal pricing attachment and a PO outline. Can you send a contract-ready SKU/pricing sheet and the SLA appendix?

Best,
Zoe Chen
Head of Product | Zenith Robotics
[Forwarded attachment: zenith-product-roadmap-may.pdf]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal — reserved GPU pool + throughput guarantees

Team — forwarding Zoe's note and procurement loop. Key asks: 24-month preference, throughput + latency SLO, ability to increase reserved pool mid-term.

Quick numbers I computed from usage CSV (conservative):
- Current 90d peak QPS: 420
- Projected steady QPS at renewal start (35% QoQ growth applied over two quarters): ~730 QPS
- Token throughput: ~1.5–1.8M tokens/day by renewal start

Recommendation (initial):
- Baseline reserved: 6x H100 (sustained handling of ~600–750 QPS depending on batching and model quantization).
- Burst policy: enable on-demand autoscale up to +4 GPUs for peak windows (effectively 10 GPUs available).
- SLA appendix to promise 95th pctl latency <=180ms for standard generation route; credits tiered by duration/severity.

Questions for pricing/ops:
- Marissa: ballpark list vs committed pricing for 24mo on 6x H100 + burst policy?
- Neha: operational constraints for mid-term pool increases (lead time, capacity guarantees)?
- Sean: any concerns about the target latency SLO given multi-tenant placement?

Attaching the usage CSV again.

Thanks,
Rafael

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal — reserved GPU pool + throughput guarantees

Rafael/Neha/Sean —

Quick pricing options (preliminary):
- 12-month term, 6x H100 reserved + burst policy: List $120,000/month; committed price (5% discount) $114,000/month.
- 24-month term, 6x H100 reserved + burst policy: List $115,000/month; committed price (10% discount) $103,500/month.
- Optional add-on: faster scale windows (+priority) for $6,000/month.

Operational notes:
- Neha: we can allow one mid-term pool increase with 10 business days notice; subsequent increases require review but can be approved if capacity exists in the region. We can add a clause for an expedited add option (2 business days) at a premium.
- Sean: latency SLO of 95th pctl <=180ms looks feasible if they agree to model quantization profile and use our prefix caching for frequent prompts. We should call this out as a dependency.

I attached the pricing workbook (renewal-pricing-zenith.xlsx). These are draft commercial terms — if Zenith likes 24 months we should prepare a redline with the SLA appendix and a PO template.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Dedicated | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: renewal-pricing-zenith.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Zoe Chen <zoe@zenith.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@zenith.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 13:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal — reserved GPU pool + throughput guarantees

Rafael/Marissa —

Zenith agrees to move forward on the 24-month committed plan with the 6x H100 reserved pool + burst policy. Procurement is attaching a PO and requests a 10% committed-term discount (your 24-month committed price aligns with what we expected). Key conditions:

- Start date: 2026-07-01 (renewal effective date)
- Clause: one mid-term pool increase allowed with 10 business days notice; expedited increase (2 business days) negotiable as a paid option.
- SLA appendix: please include the dependency language around quantization and prefix caching.

Attached is our PO stub (zenith-po-20260519.pdf). Please send over a contract redline and DocuSign route.

Thanks,
Zoe
Head of Product | Zenith Robotics
[Attachment: zenith-po-20260519.pdf (PDF)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Zoe Chen <zoe@zenith.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal proposal — reserved GPU pool + throughput guarantees

All — great news. Per Zenith's PO and internal pricing, Marissa will draft a 24-month amendment at the committed price ($103,500/month) that includes:

- Reserved pool: 6x H100 GPUs effective 2026-07-01
- Burst policy: up to +4 GPUs on-demand (expedited increases available as add-on)
- SLA appendix: 95th pctl latency <=180ms with dependency language for quantization and prefix caching
- Mid-term increase: 10 business days notice for one increase, expedited (2 business days) for paid option

Marissa — when you have the redline, please send the DocuSign link and I will coordinate signatures with Zoe/procurement. Neha and Sean: please confirm the operational playbook for the mid-term increase and the escalation path; I want those in the appendix before routing.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to closing this renewal.

Rafael
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC123-zenith]
